lines.text: You walked in and the bass line changed its mind
My feet started moving to a beat I couldn’t find
I had my own rhythm, I was steady on my own
Now I’m dancing to a song that only you have shown
You stole the tempo right out of my chest
Now I can’t move unless you give me the rest
Rhythm thief, you got me moving to your sound
Every step I take, I’m following you around
I don’t mind the hijack, I don’t mind the crime
Rhythm thief — baby, steal this beat of mine
You laugh when I trip over words I used to own
You turn my steady pulse into a rolling stone
I used to lead the dance, now I’m happy to be led
‘Cause your rhythm feels like home inside my head
You stole the tempo right out of my chest
Now I can’t move unless you give me the rest
Rhythm thief, you got me moving to your sound
Every step I take, I’m following you around
I don’t mind the hijack, I don’t mind the crime
Rhythm thief — baby, steal this beat of mine
Maybe I was waiting for someone to take the lead
Maybe I was ready for a rhythm I can’t beat
Rhythm thief, you got me moving to your sound
Every step I take, I’m following you around
I don’t mind the hijack, I don’t mind the crime
Rhythm thief — baby, steal this beat of mine
